change: Exact signed-byte extraction and i32-to-f32 conversion for shared FP32 G1 matrix loads
candidate: Baseline plus matmul.wgsl sx() conditional. First production run included an unrelated comment in the unchanged F16/G2 branch, removed before the final build and second production run. Selected FP32 G1 source is identical across both builds.

hardware.note: CDP wrapper reports headless=false; actual dedicated Chrome launch used --headless=new. All GPU jobs serial.

metric: Per-family geometric mean of three request-size GPU medians, two warmups and five measured runs per size; four-family geometric mean. Profiled GPU time, not unprofiled round-trip latency. Candidate aggregate uses both complete production runs; fresh baseline ran between them.
